description.value: Top Notch Burgers is a gourmet casual dining restaurant located inside the historic Best Western Dorchester hotel in downtown Nanaimo. Chef David Peck's team hand-crafts patties daily from a house-ground chuck blend, with bison sourced from MorningStar Ranch and buns baked fresh by local Cobbs Bakery. It is within walking distance of many downtown Nanaimo attractions and serves breakfast, brunch, and dinner menus.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 65m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is a real, operating dine-in restaurant at 70 Church Street inside the Best Western Dorchester hotel in Nanaimo. The health and safety section explicitly states 'Washrooms will be sanitized every 2 hours,' confirming on-site washrooms. A takeout menu is listed on the /eat page. Gluten-free options are confirmed by 'All burgers are gluten free with a bun replacement.' No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website only.
OSM opening_hours tags differ slightly from hours listed on the website — website should be considered authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible restaurant in downtown Nanaimo with active website and confirmed address; useful food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Restaurant is located inside the Best Western Dorchester hotel. Parking note on website: no on-site parking; nearby paid street parking and a parkade one block away on Front St.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: 'All burgers are gluten free with a bun replacement' per the /eat page; vegetarian or vegan options not explicitly mentioned
